message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the **official long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that either fall on a Monday/observed Monday or are Good Friday/Remembrance Day).  
(If you’re in a province that observes a different holiday—e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in NL or St. John’s Day in PEI—those will create additional long weekends.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Official long‑weekend span |
|---------|--------------|----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | **Jan 1** (Sunday – observed Mon Jan 2) | **Jan 1–2** (Sun–Mon) |
| Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, PEI, QC) | **Feb 20** (Monday) | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| Good Friday | **Apr 7** (Friday) | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | **May 22** (Monday) | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| Canada Day | **Jul 1** (Saturday – observed Mon Jul 3) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| Labour Day | **Sep 4** (Monday) | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | **Oct 9** (Monday) | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | **Nov 11** (Friday) | **Nov 11–13** (Fri–Sun) |
| Christmas Day | **Dec 25** (Monday) | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

> **Note:** Boxing Day falls on **Dec 26** (Tuesday) in 2023, so it isn’t an automatic long weekend unless you take an extra day off.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need provincial variations or want to include other observances, let me know.
